panels.title: Post performance
panels.description: The newest 50 posts. Visitors = people who opened the post on the site in the selected range (Ghost's web analytics); the other columns are all-time. Click a title to open the post, or for every social post about it (the Page dashboard).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT('/', p.slug, '/') AS Path,
  p.published_at AS Published,
  p.title AS Post,
  p.visibility AS Visibility,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'published') AS Comments,
  (SELECT MAX(e.email_count)  FROM emails e WHERE e.post_id = p.id) AS `Emailed to`,
  (SELECT MAX(e.opened_count) FROM emails e WHERE e.post_id = p.id) AS Opens,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members_click_events mce JOIN redirects r ON r.id = mce.redirect_id WHERE r.post_id = p.id) AS `Link clicks`,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members_created_events m WHERE m.attribution_type = 'post' AND m.attribution_id = p.id) AS Signups
FROM posts p
WHERE p.type = 'post' AND p.status = 'published'
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC
LIMIT 50

value.title: Every post about this page (the Page dashboard)

targets.rawSql:
-- months in @TZ_NAME@ time (Ghost stores UTC); its winter offset if MySQL has no time zone tables
SELECT COALESCE(CONVERT_TZ(m, '@SITE_TIMEZONE@', '+00:00'), m + INTERVAL @TZ_HOURS@ HOUR) AS time, COUNT(*) AS posts
FROM (SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(CONVERT_TZ(published_at, '+00:00', '@SITE_TIMEZONE@'), published_at - INTERVAL @TZ_HOURS@ HOUR), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATETIME) AS m
      FROM posts WHERE type = 'post' AND status = 'published' AND $__timeFilter(published_at)) x
GROUP BY m ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Comments per day (last 90 days)
panels.description: Published comments each day in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d', 0), COUNT(*) AS comments
FROM comments
WHERE status = 'published' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent comments
panels.description: The newest published comments, with who wrote them and on which post.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.created_at AS Posted,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(m.name, ''), 'Member') AS `By`,
  p.title AS Post,
  LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.html, '<[^>]+>', ''), 160) AS Comment
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = c.member_id
WHERE c.status = 'published'
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Live shows (selected range)
panels.description: Shows recorded by the bridge from TinyIce's status (live.json), every 30 s while /stream-ogg (@DJ_SOFTWARE@) is connected; a drop under 5 minutes doesn't end a show, and ones under 3 minutes aren't kept. Listener-hours = listeners × time, all mounts together. Recording started when the bridge got stats.mjs.

panels.description: On air now (and listeners, all mounts) as the bridge last read TinyIce, and what went wrong if anything
